main.description: Re-classify an existing intake into a different project. Used when the LLM-driven classification was wrong, or when a new project should be created and the intake reassigned. Writes a new edge_manimani_belongs_to and demotes the previous primary edge. Per ADR-2605080800.

targetProjectId.description: Existing vertex_manimani_project.vertex_id to bind to. Mutually exclusive with newProject.

newProject.description: Create a new project and bind the intake to it. Mutually exclusive with targetProjectId.

demoted.description: edge_id of previously-primary edges that were demoted to is_primary=false.

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: Both targetProjectId and newProject set, or neither.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: intakeId or targetProjectId not found in actor scope.
